bugReport.title: Report a bug
bugReport.intro: Tell us what went wrong. Below you can see everything that will be sent.
bugReport.accountEmail: If you keep "Account details" ticked below, we can reply to your account email.
bugReport.emailHint: Only if you want a reply.
bugReport.page: Page address (the part after ? is left out)
bugReport.timeWhy: To match the report with what happened on our side.
bugReport.deviceWhy: Some problems happen only in one browser or screen size.
bugReport.settingsWhy: The page can look and work differently with each.
bugReport.accountWhy: So we can reply and check your account.
bugReport.diagnostics: Recent failed requests and console errors
bugReport.diagnosticsWhy: They show what broke just before you reported it.
bugReport.screenshotWhy: So we see what you saw.
bugReport.screenshotFailed: The screenshot could not be taken. You can still send the report.
bugReport.screenshotAlt: The screenshot that will be sent
bugReport.screenshotMasked: Password and code fields are covered.
bugReport.problemWhy: So we can run your code the same way.
bugReport.problemNote: This includes the code you wrote and the last result.
bugReport.privacy: Reports are kept for up to 180 days and only the site's operators read them.
bugReport.sent: Thank you. Your report was sent.
bugReport.tooMany: Too many reports. Try again later.
bugReport.failed: Could not send the report. You can email us instead:
